description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0170)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of title determination for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, property locations, and title classifications - all falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
